name: Process / Workflow
purpose: Represent immutable released operational-flow definitions and append-only instance evidence while keeping reusable procedure knowledge, task identity, assignments and atomic acts with their authoritative masters.

owns: process family and concurrently valid variants
steps gateways roles and state model
process instances and their pinned definition references
step executions deviations escalations and compensations
delegates: reusable method and procedure editions to WM-ACT-009
atomic act identity to WM-ACT-002 when referenced
organization and performer identity to external masters
policy and rule identity to external knowledge masters
excludes: process execution as proof of method publication
assignment state as evidence of performed work
BPMN or CMMN planned paths as observed trace

constraints: variantKey is mandatory; __default__ is the reserved sentinel for a single-variant family
knowledgeEditionPins is zero-to-many
each knowledge pin is edition id+digest only; adopter-specific adoption is resolved at instance scope
step definitions retain entryCondition, exitCondition and expectedDuration when applicable

ProcessInstance.state: derived from immutable ProcessEvent records; never stored as authoritative status

WorkItem.state: derived from WorkItemEvent records; never stored as authoritative status

constraints: immutable observed event
knowledgePins is zero-to-many and must be permitted by the definition pins
missing performer requires a same-unit performer-unknown deviation
correction is a successor event
evidenceRefs may be empty only when evidenceAbsentReason is present
authorization-gap deviation and execution are one atomic append unit

Compensation.state: immutable event; compensated state of target is derived

constraints: binds only records with eventSequence greater than its own
never alters pins already written
backdating requires separately scoped authority and never repoints prior records

domains.fitness: number in [0,1] or null when not computable

constraints: pinRegimes is ordered and each regime carries sequence bounds, definition id+digest, zero-to-many knowledge edition id+digest pins and cutoverRef
coverage other than complete permits only outcome=inconclusive
resultDigest covers input tuple and measures but excludes conformanceResultId and computedAt
equal input tuple cannot yield unequal measures under one rule-set version
counterfactual requires priorResultRef and forbids supersedesResultRef
supersedesResultRef is allowed only for the same pin regimes under a newer rule set
eventSequence is strictly monotonic per instance
unknown kinds are rejected
external to immutable legacy bytes

relations.purpose: Pin the exact immutable method edition and adopter-owned adoption record used by a released definition and execution.
Reference Task identity from a work item without remastering the task.
Reference the authority or assignment that authorized work; execution remains observed evidence.
Reference one or more atomic acts without transferring their identity or asserting one-to-one cardinality.
Proposed restoration of the held governing-policy relation; no mastership transfer.

operations.effect: Issue one immutable version in a variant lineage.
Create an instance pinned to one released definition.
Create a work item without asserting execution.
Append observed performance with definition and method pins.
Append an explicit departure or exception.
Append a new execution linked to the execution it compensates.
Compute a reproducible projection over a pinned definition and trace.

invariants: Every process instance pins process family, mandatory variant (using __default__ for a single-variant family), released-definition id and digest, zero-to-many knowledge edition id+digest pins, any applicable adopter-owned adoption record, and recorded-at time.
Every step execution repeats its applicable family, variant, definition, method-edition, adoption and recorded-at pins.
Draft definitions are not citable by instances or executions.
Variants are concurrent alternatives; versions form acyclic supersession lineages within one variant.
Released definitions and trace records are immutable and content-addressed.
A method edition affects new instances only through an effective adoption record.
An in-flight change requires an explicit authorized CutoverRecord; otherwise the original pins remain.
A completed trace is never repointed by a definition, method-edition or adoption successor.
A WorkItem references Task identity in vr.wm-act-006 and never becomes the Task master.
Assignment and execution are separate facts; an assignment may have zero executions.
Execution without a surviving applicable assignment requires an explicit deviation.
A planned path never proves an observed path.
Trace order is append-only and monotonic per instance.
Correction is a successor execution with a reason and never mutates the historical event.
Every known departure, manual exception or authorization gap is an explicit deviation.
Compensation is append-only, preserves the applicable pins, and links its target execution.
A remount to different pins requires an explicit CutoverRecord referenced by the compensation.
StepExecution may reference zero or more atomic acts; cardinality remains a held crosswalk.
Missing trace evidence yields partial or unknown coverage and never conformance pass.
ConformanceResult is immutable and reproducible from definition digest, method-edition digest, trace digest and rule-set version.
A counterfactual conformance replay is labelled and never replaces the historical result.
No floating conformant flag is authoritative on an instance.
External BPMN, CMMN and process-mining standards are alignments only until pinned crosswalk evidence exists.
Publication is refused while fixturesExecuted is false, publishableCanonical is false or any release hold is open.
A definition, instance and execution use mandatory variantKey; __default__ is the only no-alternative sentinel.
All trace state is derived from immutable events; direct status mutation is forbidden.
Every trace record participates in one strictly monotonic cross-type event sequence.
Knowledge pins are zero-to-many; their absence never causes a synthetic edition.
Where a work item and its execution both cite assignments, they agree or an assignment-divergence deviation is present.
Withdrawn knowledge editions remain digest-resolvable for every historical pin.
Legacy assembly identifiers can never label a successor candidate version.
A local Task, Assignment, Act or Policy master is never minted to satisfy an optional reference.
holds: The single frozen semantic audit and its one-pass remediation are pending.
CRUD, roles, artifacts and executable package conversion are absent.
Relations are candidate-only until ledger approval.
StepExecution-to-atomic-act cardinality and cross-system trace mastership remain unverified.
External notation and standards crosswalks are alignments rather than conformance claims.
External registry ids vr.wm-act-006 and vr.wm-org-016 are unverified against the frozen reservation registry; their references remain optional.
WM-ACT-002 COMPOSE-to-REFERENCE and WM-KNW-012 relation changes are proposed ledger amendments only.

digestPolicy.canonicalization: RFC8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme for candidate records
digestPolicy.digestDomain: normative object content excluding local display labels and record identifiers explicitly named outside each digest

alignmentPolicy: Only a source with an exact version or digest may appear; every entry must state claim=alignment-only. No current pinned alignment is claimed.

registryActions: Bind legacy assembly id permanently to 0.2.0-legacy
Record K3/K6 spec-path rename without editing legacy bytes

referencePolicy: Every *Ref field resolves through referenceTypes; external-unmastered references must carry namespace, source and resolution rule.

traceContract.ordering: strictly increasing eventSequence per instance across all record types
traceContract.traceDigestOrder: eventSequence ascending, then canonical record digest
atomicAppendUnits: execution plus authorization-gap deviation when no applicable assignment
execution plus performer-unknown deviation when performer is absent

tombstonePolicy: A protected referent may be tombstoned by removing referent content while preserving the reference token, event identity, event sequence and historical record digest.

authorityRules.cutover: process owner or an in-scope delegation record
authorityRules.adoption: owned by vr.wm-act-009 and scoped to the adopting organization

referenceTypes.actorRef: external actor master or system actor
referenceTypes.performerRef: external actor master or system actor

contracts.scope: authorized trace access with purpose binding
de-identified aggregates only; suppress case and actor identity

projections.authority: derived from pinned trace and rule set
